registration: Frozen before the first #201 real-checkpoint measurement, 2026-11-19
scope: one fixed model window per Cas, all 9 SpCas9 heads and the Cas12a head; no generalization to other sequences

cases.heads: all SPCAS9_VARIANTS including PAM-incompatible heads for numerical qualification

ig.baseline: zero sequence token embeddings, keep special embeddings; ESM mask-dropout compensation and position ids match input-id prediction

shap.background: seeded random ACGT onehot, includes PAM; n increases share RNG prefix
shap.disk_cache: fresh compute then save/load equality; never use legacy files

tolerances.finite: all predictions, gradients, attributions, baselines, errors, rollout arrays
tolerances.stability_rule: max abs(candidate-reference) <= atol + rtol * max abs(reference); per axis against seed (0,0) at same setting; IG adjacent step counts
tolerances.prediction_parity: preserved CSV base columns byte equality; raw allclose atol 1e-8 rtol 1e-5

display_policy: finite results retain all graphs even when numerical gates fail; no quality warning banner/popup; internal diagnostics; existing exception/no-result/nonfinite errors remain
precision_policy: optional 256-step IG and 128/8 SHAP; preserve default 32/64/4, progress and cancellation; quality is reported separately for each setting

source_statistics.formula: Ytr = train[H].values.astype(float32) / 100; mu=nanmean(Ytr,0); sd=nanstd(Ytr,0), ddof=0; source SHA256 and recomputed values recorded in report
